issue.title: Make the prompt `<space>` and `<ctrl+n/p>` project-cycling keys instant
issue.description: Opening the prompt bar with `<space>` and cycling the current-project stack with `<ctrl+n>` / `<ctrl+p>` become in-memory operations. Neither key path reads or writes the VCS MRU, lists project records, spawns a subprocess, or stops, starts, or joins a watcher on the event loop. Warm `<ctrl+n/p>` key-to-paint p95 is at most 16 ms. `<space>` reveals a pre-built bar with key-to-paint p95 at most 60 ms. There are no multi-hundred-millisecond first-press or first-visit spikes. Launch, prefill, history, and cycling semantics stay unchanged.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md requests this work

issue.title: Prompt-key perf instrumentation, benchmark, and I/O probes
issue.description: key-perf-harness: record `SASE_TUI_PERF` key-to-paint samples for `<space>`, `ctrl+n`, and `ctrl+p`; add a slow bench plus a non-slow smoke test; add a main-thread I/O probe helper that later phases use for zero-I/O tests; record a baseline.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase key-perf-harness as one work unit

issue.title: App-owned launchable-MRU snapshot for project cycling
issue.description: mru-snapshot: add an immutable launchable-MRU snapshot owned by `AceApp`. A single-flight worker builds it, and peek-token ticks and launch/set-current triggers keep it fresh. `ctrl+n/p` read it only, pin it per prompt session, and show a hint instead of editing when it is cold.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase mru-snapshot as one work unit

issue.title: Serve `<space>` and the other MRU-head entry points from the snapshot
issue.description: space-prefill: resolve the `<space>` prefill from the snapshot without I/O. A cold or launch-pending snapshot opens a blank bar at once and applies a late prefill only to an untouched session. Move `,.` and the editor entry point to the snapshot, and remove every MRU write from key paths.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase space-prefill as one work unit

issue.title: One project-record pass and memoized provider detection per MRU build
issue.description: mru-build-efficiency: make one launchable-MRU build list project records once and detect each project's provider once, using per-call (never process-global) state, with the pruning semantics unchanged.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase mru-build-efficiency as one work unit

issue.title: Pure catalog getters, non-blocking watcher growth, and a wakeable watcher stop
issue.description: watcher-growth: stop catalog getters from restarting the prompt-source watcher. Grow watches off the pump with `ensure_watches` and reconcile once afterward. Add a self-pipe so `ArtifactWatcher.stop()` never waits out the 0.5 s `select`.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase watcher-growth as one work unit

issue.title: Run each prompt text-area mount, unmount, and worker hook once
issue.description: mount-dedup: replace the mixins' super-chained, Textual-dispatched `on_mount`, `on_unmount`, and `on_worker_state_changed` handlers with cooperative hooks that are dispatched once. Body order and theme layering stay the same, and goldens stay unchanged.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase mount-dedup as one work unit

issue.title: One highlight build and no pump-side Jinja inspect per cycle edit
issue.description: cycle-edit-coalesce: batch highlight-map builds so a cycle edit pays for one. Make the queued Changed/SelectionChanged context refreshes no-ops when nothing changed, skip the needless arg-hint refresh, and move the Jinja diagnostics inspect into a pump-free task.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase cycle-edit-coalesce as one work unit

issue.title: Quiet the work that follows opening or editing the prompt
issue.description: post-open-quiet: repaint the Agents detail only when a warmed context matches the selected agent, and defer that repaint while a prompt is active. Stagger non-essential bar warm-ups by one paint, and hoist the first-mount imports.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase post-open-quiet as one work unit

issue.title: Freeze startup objects and log gen-2 GC pauses
issue.description: gc-policy: once startup loads finish, run `gc.collect(); gc.freeze()` at idle. Register an allocation-light, I/O-free `gc.callbacks` hook whose gen-2 pause records reach the stall/perf logs off the calling thread. Coordinate with the separate TUI-freeze investigation.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase gc-policy as one work unit

issue.title: Explicit prompt-active state and one prompt-bar accessor
issue.description: prompt-active-state: track the active prompt bar explicitly on the app so `_prompt_input_active()` no longer queries the DOM. Route every `#prompt-input-bar` and `PromptInputBar` lookup through one accessor, which is the prerequisite for a hidden spare bar.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/prompt_space_and_project_cycle_latency.md defines phase prompt-active-state as one work unit

issue.title: Make `<space>` reveal a pre-built hidden prompt bar
issue.description: space-hot-spare: after re-measuring, keep one fresh, inert, hidden, id-less prompt bar mounted at idle. `<space>` seeds it, reveals it, and calls a new `activate()`. Other prompt modes keep fresh mounts, and every session still gets a new instance.
